author: Zegita
body:
IGN: Zegita
Reason I was banned: Anti-Knockback(Hacking)
Why I should be unbanned from the server?: At that time I only hacked for trolling and yes it was stupid but I have paid for my mistakes. It's been almost 4 months since I've been banned and I don't hack anymore. I promise you I do not hack anymore in fact I am a good pvper and you can check it out at my channel(ZegitaHD) sorry if that was advertising. Honestly, I respect your decisions but I hope I can be unbanned as I know for a fact that I do not hack anymore. At that time, I just wanted to have a bit of fun(dont' we all? :P). 

So I respect your decisions fairly and I hope I can be unbanned as I really actually love that server and I've been playing it for 2 years. :)
